info.title: Tasklore API
info.description: REST API of Tasklore. Browsers authenticate with the session cookie; scripts, the CLI and MCP clients with a personal access token (`Authorization: Bearer tl_pat_…`).

get.summary: Show version, runtime and database information
List all users

post.summary: Create a local user
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List all groups with their global permissions

post.summary: Create a group
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Add a user to a group
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group

get.summary: List custom fields, archived ones included

post.summary: Create a custom field
post.description:
Names are unique without regard to case and must not be a system field, TQL function or keyword.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

patch.summary: Change, archive or restore a custom field
patch.description:
Options are given as the full list; entries with an id are renamed or archived, entries without one are added, missing ones are archived.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get the working time used for durations

put.summary: Change the working time used for durations
put.description:
Stored values stay in seconds; "1d" and "1w" are read and shown with the new lengths from now on.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Sign out and end the current session

get.summary: List the sign-in methods this installation offers
List boards in projects the caller can see

post.summary: Create a board located in a project
post.description: Requires the permission `administer` in that project. Starts with one column per workflow status (E-53).

get.summary: Get a board’s configuration

patch.summary: Configure a board: scope, columns, WIP limits, quick filters, swimlanes
patch.description: Columns and quick filters are given as full lists in display order.

delete.summary: Delete a board; its issues stay

get.summary: The board with its cards in rank order (at most 500)
get.description: `filters` narrows with quick filters: "mine", "recent" or ids of the board’s own, combined with AND.

post.summary: Move a card into a column and between two cards
post.description: Runs the workflow transition to the first status of the column the issue can reach (409 if none), then ranks it between `afterKey` and `beforeKey`.

get.summary: List saved filters the caller can see

post.summary: Save a TQL query as a filter
post.description: Sharing requires the global permission `share-filters`.

get.summary: Get a saved filter

delete.summary: Delete a saved filter (owner or administrator)
Remove a filter from the favourites

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running
Readiness: the database is reachable
List the attachments of an issue

post.summary: Attach a file to an issue
post.description: multipart/form-data with the file in the field `file`; needs the project permission `comment`. The size limit is `attachmentMaxBytes` from /tracking/meta.

delete.summary: Delete an attachment (own, or any as project administrator)

get.summary: Download the content of an attachment
get.description: Verified raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) are served inline unless `download=1`; everything else always as a download.

get.summary: List issue types, statuses, priorities, resolutions and link types

post.summary: Create an issue

get.summary: Get an issue by key

patch.summary: Change fields of an issue; every change is recorded in its history

get.summary: List the workflow transitions available from the current status

post.summary: Move an issue to another status

put.summary: Rank an issue between two others
put.description: The rank is global: the order is the same on every board and backlog (T-BRD-10). Needs `edit-issues`.

get.summary: List the comments of an issue

post.summary: Add a comment to an issue

get.summary: List the change history of an issue, newest first

delete.summary: Delete a comment (own, or any as project administrator)

post.summary: Link the issue to another issue
post.description: Requires `edit-issues` on this issue and browse access to the other one.

get.summary: List the work logged on an issue, newest first

post.summary: Log work on an issue
post.description: Needs `edit-issues`. Durations like "1d 4h" use the instance’s working time (`workingTime` in /tracking/meta). The remaining estimate drops by the logged time unless `remaining` says otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a worklog (own, or any as project administrator)

get.summary: Get the signed-in user
List the signed-in user’s active sessions

delete.summary: End one of the signed-in user’s sessions

get.summary: List the signed-in user’s personal access tokens

post.summary: Create a personal access token; the secret is returned only once

get.summary: List the caller’s notifications, newest first
Count unread notifications
get.description: Cheap enough to poll; the web app asks every 30 seconds and on focus (E-44).

post.summary: Mark notifications as read

get.summary: Get the caller’s notification settings
List the caller’s favourites
get.description: Projects and saved filters; items the caller can no longer see are left out.

put.summary: Star a project (key) or saved filter (id)

post.summary: Remember that the caller opened an issue or project
post.description: Sent by the web app when a page opens; scripts normally do not call it (E-46).

get.summary: List recently opened issues and projects, newest first
Get the caller’s columns for issue result lists
get.description: Key and summary are always shown; these are the further columns, in order.

put.summary: Choose the caller’s columns for issue result lists

get.summary: Activity stream: new issues, changes and comments, newest first
get.description: Optionally for one project or one person; page with `before` = `next`.

get.summary: List the projects the caller can see

post.summary: Create a project from a template
post.description: Requires the global permission `create-projects`. The creator becomes project administrator.

get.summary: Get a project with its issue types, statuses and the caller’s permissions
List the issues of a project in rank order
Find people who can work in the project
get.description: For assignees and @-mentions: active users who may browse the project. Needs no global `browse-users`.

get.summary: List the components of a project

post.summary: Create a component
post.description: Requires the project permission `administer`.

delete.summary: Delete a component; issues lose it

put.summary: Choose the custom fields a project uses, in display order
put.description: Requires the project permission `administer`. Values of fields switched off stay stored but are hidden (E-50).

post.summary: Search issues with TQL
post.description: Runs a TQL query over the projects the caller can browse. An invalid query answers 400 with `queryErrors` (code, message and position of each error).

get.summary: Suggest stored values for a TQL field
get.description: For autocompletion: `value` is the canonical text to put into the query.

get.summary: Report whether first-run setup is still required

post.summary: Create the first administrator with the setup code and sign in

get.summary: The backlog of a Scrum board: open sprints with their issues, then the rest
List the sprints of a board

post.summary: Plan a new sprint on a Scrum board

patch.summary: Change name, goal or dates of a sprint

delete.summary: Delete a planned sprint; its issues go to the backlog

post.summary: Start a planned sprint
post.description: One sprint runs per board. The estimates at this moment are the commitment.

post.summary: Complete the running sprint
post.description: Unfinished issues go to the backlog, a new sprint (`"new"`) or a planned sprint (its id).

post.summary: Move issues into a sprint or (sprintId null) to the backlog
post.description: Each issue leaves its current open sprint; the change is in its history.

get.summary: Find active users by name or email
get.description:
Requires the global permission `browse-users`.

Requires the global permission `browse-users`.

get.summary: List webhooks

post.summary: Create a webhook
post.description:
Deliveries are signed per Standard Webhooks (headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`). The secret is only returned here and when rotated.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: Get a webhook

patch.description:
Enabling a webhook the system switched off also clears its failure state.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

delete.summary: Delete a webhook and its delivery log

post.summary: Replace the signing secret
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.

post.summary: Send a test message now
post.description:
Returns the delivery with the receiver’s answer.

Requires the global permission `admin`.

get.summary: List recent deliveries of a webhook (kept 30 days)

post.summary: Send a delivery again now
post.description: Requires the global permission `admin`.
